futility.derivative: Symmetric 0.1 degree difference of the selected chain LoS M1-R at the timeline truth pose and nominal true distance as the zero-width prior. Keep fixed geometry and signed sensitivity.
futility.sensitivity_threshold_reason: Below 0.01 s/rad a residual of 0.001 already linearizes to over 0.1 rad. Count low-sensitivity checkpoints separately.
futility.window: Exactly the prior 5 m accumulated from frozen distance_increment_m; distance-weighted left hold between packet positions. Zero-distance holds contribute no extra weight. Start at TEACH then carry distance history and DR elapsed time into nominal REPEAT. Each P-C route has a fresh origin.
futility.checkpoints: Each TEACH/REPEAT station last sweep or hold packet and the nearest measured packet to each transit midpoint. Use the first packet meeting each full-distance multiple of max(1 m, 2 ell_d) on P-B and P-C. ell_d is the pooled G-T1 C3 estimate for the evaluated RF chain.
futility.dr: 40 common seeds numbered 0–39 and signs [-1,1] per path. B0/L0/L1/L2 0/.01/.05/.20 deg/s, Sensor-v2 white gyro density .015 deg/sqrt(s) and zero bias random walk. TB3 uses signed .0085/.0020 times absolute angular travel plus signed .0005 deg/s Allan bag stationary drift during recorded holds. Same gyro noise draw for each scenario and sign. Equivalent bias is scale times sum of absolute angular increments / elapsed time. r2.1.0 is PRELIMINARY.

bootstrap.unit: Equal checkpoint weight for the S2-F point gate. Report non-gating percentile intervals on the pooled RMS using sites within anchors then common matched sensor seed IDs.
bootstrap.site: TEACH/REPEAT uses the common station ID for revisits and a distinct midpoint segment ID; P-C uses nonoverlapping consecutive L_seg segments.

estimates.C1: P-A TEACH/REPEAT five-point unique RF poses. Estimate within-pose sample variances from detected draws and pool by degrees of freedom for each SNR.
estimates.C2: Unique position plus wrapped-yaw pose, fixed S2 spatial fit sets. Merge neighboring bins below 200 poses or 10 sites. Estimate centered-at-zero q95(abs(e))/1.96 for each bin and fit log variance with second differences, discarding knots outside empirical support. C2-w is the pooled unmodeled residual q95 variance without using fitted knots. Penalty selection uses reciprocal inner leave-one-anchor-out among the outer fold training donors only, pooling Gaussian likelihood on supported points. Smaller penalty breaks ties.
estimates.C2_range_conditional: Retain the offset-only C2 and pooled white estimate for R4/R-M. For R-MC separately characterize within-donor deviations after b_r and subtraction of empirical donor bin mean, leaving the between-donor component to K_r. Donor means are used for offline variance pooling only. Signed s is never corrected by subtracting donor means.
estimates.C3: Use v2 sequence lag pairs, weighted by count, with nugget plus exponential kernel. Fit pooled spatial C3 using the shortest contributing reference path length/3 as upper bound; include each length in results. Bounds 0.016 m to path cap and 2.5 to 60 degrees. At the lower bound switch that channel to white; at upper bound require the matching consider state for selection.
estimates.C4: At each P-D offset pair target residual with its source_pose_id. Pair TEACH/REPEAT selected five-point poses on station and nominal angle. Report P-E same source pairing as a separate correlation.
estimates.C5: Per path and anchor report 5 m residual-window mean and population variance, checkpoint residual variance, and their ratio V_long wherever the denominator is positive. Evaluate TEACH/REPEAT and C1–C4, with P-B separately.
estimates.C6: r_tilde = noiseless measured range minus S1 prime offset. Estimate donor-common mean slant-range residual by r_tilde bin in supported interval. Between-support knots linear, outside hold endpoint. After b_r, K_r uses squared paired donor bin-mean difference/2 pooled over bins with both donors.
estimates.C7: Normalize by fitted supported sigma_b(rho), use first ordered pose per site and fit Student-t location 0, free scale. Use nu=max(nu_hat,3). Site reuses physical station (shared across TEACH/REPEAT); paths use disjoint max(1 m,2 ell_d) distance segments.
estimates.C8: Report |ds/dpsi| quantiles at every P-A and P-C straight and sweep/turn checkpoint with mount 0.
estimates.S2-T: Compute signed residual-to-consider standard-deviation ratios in excluded-anchor supported windows/bins using training donors only. Retain numerators, denominators and non-finite cases explicitly. Threshold strictly abs(Z)>2. This does not select an arm.
